slice_1_github_truth_adapter.description: Bounded read-only GitHub truth adapter using GitHub App installation tokens via GitHubAppTokenManager. Returns typed Pydantic evidence models (12 classes): InstallationAccess, RepositoryIdentity, RemoteRefObservation, CommitPresence, CompareResult, CIStatusEvidence, CheckRunEvidence, PublicationVerification. Typed error vocabulary (GitHubTruthErrorKind, 15 kinds). Publication verification distinguishes exact_promoted, accepted_with_follow_on_commits, target_behind, target_divergent, expected_commit_missing, remote_unavailable, permission_unavailable.
slice_1_github_truth_adapter.test_coverage: 30 causal contract tests via respx: token non-disclosure (4 tests with hostile sentinels), permission insufficiency (2), token expiry, rate limiting, missing refs, commit presence (exact, follow-on, absent), compare (identical, with files), CI status (success, failure with hostile log content, pending), publication verification (exact promoted, follow-on, expected missing, CI failing, divergent, permission unavailable), ref observation, evidence identity stability, malformed response, timeout.

slice_2_publication_verification_tool.description: Built-in read-only tool (GitHubTruthTool) exposing 6 operations: verify_publication, observe_ci_status, observe_ref, check_commit_presence, observe_installation_access, observe_repository. Uses appropriate NONDETERMINISTIC_EXTERNAL_IO determinism and READ_ONLY mutation. Follows BaseTool pattern with ToolUIData integration.
slice_2_publication_verification_tool.test_coverage: 12 tool-level tests: exact publication, follow-on detection, CI failure reporting, ref observation, missing arg refusal, unknown action handling, installation access, token non-disclosure from tool results.

slice_3_builtin_tool_contract_closure.description: Canonical contract coverage artifact documenting 32 built-in tools. Enhanced github_ci_cd.py: added error_kind field to GitHubToolResult, typed error vocabulary (_GITHUB_ERROR_KINDS: token_unavailable, not_found, permission_denied, rate_limited, timeout, network_error), structured HTTP status code classification replacing raw exception strings in error messages. Documented Lane A and Lane C parked dependencies.
known_gaps: git_hub_tool: mutation_class is EXTERNAL_SIDE_EFFECT for all operations including read-only ones — per-operation classification deferred.
task: subagent delegation spans read-only and workspace writes — per-operation classification deferred.

slice_4_operator_evidence_ux.description: Operator projection models: GitHubConnectionProjection, PublicationStatusProjection (8 states with human labels), CIStateProjection, RepositoryProjection, ToolExecutionProjection, OperatorDashboardProjection. Content-light: no raw paths, tokens, secrets. Progressive disclosure support via evidence digests. Dashboard digest computation for state change detection.
slice_4_operator_evidence_ux.test_coverage: 15 projection tests: connection states, publication labels, CI labels, repository branch confinement, dashboard build, content-light assertion, secret non-disclosure (hostile sentinels), digest stability, digest change on state mutation, JSON serialization.
